producer: gpt-5.6-sol executing Google OKF web_ingestion_instruction.md verbatim per source (the reference implementation's only document pathway)
judge: gpt-5.6-sol via Codex MCP, read-only, fresh session per source (same-family grader caveat applies, as in the prior round)
method: Full census: every minted note, no per-source cap. Per source, a fresh read-only session read each note in full, then verified every substantive claim by targeted ripgrep search against the source (multiple phrasings) and read of matching regions; labels FAITHFUL / MINOR-DRIFT / UNSUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED; strict, grade down on doubt. Large textbook sources were verified by targeted per-claim search rather than a cover-to-cover read (a session that could not read a source whole was instructed to say so and not grade on a partial read).
selection_note: The prior sample's 6 sources were stratified by minting volume (two highest-minting, two mid-band, largest book, one small) and skewed toward the busier, more error-prone sources; the full census including the cleaner long tail lands slightly LOWER (7.2% vs 9.4%), which removes any cherry-pick concern.
reproducibility_note: Blind re-audit (judge told nothing of the prior audit). Of the 3 committed accounting-vol2 exhibits, 2 re-flagged as hard errors (time_value_of_money_conventions, balanced_scorecard_perspectives) and 1 downgraded to MINOR-DRIFT (investment_center_performance_measures). Of the 2 economics-3e exhibits, money_supply_and_multiplier re-flagged as CONTRADICTED and income_distribution_measures downgraded to MINOR-DRIFT. Downgrades cut against the finding, i.e. the honest direction.
